# Solo Product Builder PRD

## Product model

A solo product builder turns customer evidence into one canonical product decision record.
The record is the product's source of truth; generated views never become competing copies.

## Current release

The builder can create a decision record from interview notes, record its rationale, and
export a read-only brief. These commitments define the current release.

## Observed use

After collecting new evidence, builders duplicate the old record before revisiting a
decision because they fear losing its original rationale. The copies then disagree about the
current decision.

## Later work

Multiple-project reporting is a paid expansion. Team collaboration is a future hypothesis
that requires evidence. General project management is outside the product boundary.
